verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments API and gateway: checkout, transfers, virtual accounts, bill pay and webhooks. It has no agent or AI runtime that could act as an MCP client and use tools from plugged-in servers, so this client-side axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
